The implementation appears to meet the ordinary cases, but `mask_secret(value, keep_last=0)` slices with `value[-0:]`, which returns the full value and exposes the secret. I’ll run the suite to check for other regressions; the reported tests do not cover this boundary case.

The tests pass, but `mask_secret` exposes the entire secret when `keep_last=0`: `value[-0:]` is the full string. With zero characters to keep, it should mask all characters, so this can leak a secret.
